text:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's DR postmortem — I kicked off a thread to consolidate open action items for the regional failover runbooks and backups verification. We need clear owners + dates. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-postmortem-2026 (please comment with ownership).

maria: High level items I captured: 1) restore runbook gaps for regional DB failover, 2) multi-region routing playbook (BGP + infra-level rollbacks), 3) automated backup verification, 4) game-day checklist + cadence.

tj: I'll own the DB restore runbook updates. I'll add step-by-step for GCS snapshot imports and KMS key rotation caveats by Friday (1812400000). :thumbsup:

lee: Taking routing playbook. Will add explicit router ACLs, BGP preference testing steps, and a revert path. ETA: next Tue (1812610000). I'll also add a smoke test to validate app traffic after route change.

sanjay: Agree we need automated verification for backups. ops-bot currently logs manual checks but not automated validation. Proposal: weekly job that does a dry-restore to staging and runs checksum diff. I'll prototype the job and PR the pipeline by Monday.

kelsey: For the game-day checklist: add communications runbook and PagerDuty escalation matrix (2nd-level -> infra -> exec). I'll coordinate with comms and legal for the notification templates. ETA: 3/2.

ops-bot: backup-checker ran: last_full_backup=1812300000, last_validate=1812310000, status=partial (missing incremental for eu-west-2).

maria: @sanjay good call. Include SLA expectations for restore time (RTO) and maximum allowable data loss (RPO) per region. We'll align with product on acceptable windows.

tj: Quick note — we found an ambiguous step in the current runbook around switching read replicas. I'll add a clearly marked "pre-switchover" checklist with commands and expected timings. Example snippet: ```
# promote replica
gcloud sql instances promote-replica my-replica --region=eu-west-2
# verify replication lag < 5s
SELECT NOW() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();
```

lee: Also adding a traffic validation curl script to confirm model-serving endpoints come up: ```
for i in 1..10; do curl -sS -f https://api.eu.example.com/health || exit 1; done
``` will be in the playbook.

sanjay: For automation: will submit a Jenkins pipeline job that runs monthly dry-restores to a read-only namespace. Will include a Prometheus metric and alert if validation fails.

kelsey: Thinking about recurring patterns: the postmortem noted flapping between regions during high load. We should add a pre-failover capacity check and a throttling knob in the routing policy. I'll propose settings (max concurrent streams per host) and run a load test in staging.

maria: To avoid owner drift, let's use a single tracker doc with one line per action: owner, description, due_ts, status. I've created the tracker and assigned initial owners (please verify): https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-followups-tracker (comment on the row to accept).

tj: Accepted ownership of "DB restore runbook — GCS snapshot path". Setting due_ts=1812400000.

lee: Accepted ownership of "Routing playbook — BGP revert steps" due_ts=1812610000.

sanjay: Accepted ownership of "Backup automation — weekly dry-restore" due_ts=1812460000.

kelsey: Accepted ownership of "Game-day comms + escalation" due_ts=1812720000.

maria: One more: let's schedule a mini game-day (failover rehearsal) next month to validate new runbooks and the automated checks. Volunteers for observers and participants?

tj: I'll participate and bring DB ops checklist.

lee: I'll run the routing changes in staging and be on call for rollbacks.

sanjay: I'll own the backup validation during the exercise.

kelsey: I'll coordinate comms and post-exercise retro notes.

maria: Perfect. I'll follow up with calendar invites and mark the tracker rows as "in progress". If anyone hits blockers on their PRs or needs extra reviewer bandwidth ping #eng-oncall or @maria.

tj: small blocker — need KMS access for the GCS import tests. @security-team can you grant a short-lived key to ci-runner?

maria: Noted, adding Security for expedited grant.

ops-bot: reminder: scheduled run "backup-validator" will run 1812403600.

lee: thanks — I'll coordinate the routing dry-run the day before the game-day.

maria: Thanks all. Let's close items as PRs land. I'll re-open thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
